prompt: Look at the photograph and choose the statement that best describes it.
promptZh: 請看照片，選出最符合畫面的敘述。

options.text: Both panels rest on the shelf.
options.whyZh: 兩塊板都從上方懸掛，與下方層板有明顯空隙。

options.text: The panels overlap in the middle.
options.zh: 兩塊板在中間互相重疊。
options.whyZh: 兩塊板之間有清楚空隙，沒有互相遮擋。

options.text: Both straps on each panel have been removed.
options.zh: 每塊板的兩條帶子都被拆掉了。
options.whyZh: 兩塊板仍各有兩條帶子連接橫桿與板面。

options.text: One panel is hanging lower than the other.
options.whyZh: 兩塊板由同一根橫桿支撐；紅板上緣和下緣都低於綠板。

explanationZh: 兩塊板由同一根橫桿支撐；紅板上緣和下緣都低於綠板。
evidence: Two panels hang from a common rail. Each has two straps. The right-hand red panel’s longer straps hold it lower, clear of the empty shelf.

vocabulary.note: 比較兩片帆布下緣的位置，不表示其中一片比較短。
